description: Creates an instance DB of an FB. Refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the name matches, ignoring case, any tag, constant or block of the PLC. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/instancedbs. M-off.

autoNumber.description: accepted for compatibility and ignored: without 'number' the serve picks the number itself

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

instanceOf.description: name of the FB to instantiate from

number.description: block number ≥1, used as given (a number another DB holds is refused by TIA); omitted or 0 ⇒ the serve picks the lowest free number from 1 in the DB family (409 block_number_exhausted when none is free)

name: tia_instancedb_create
title: TIA — create instance DB
